messages:
ana: Quick question for the thread  build your ultimate 3-song capsule that fixes your mood. drop the three tracks and one nice-to-have pairing (book/show/movie). i'll start.
mike: 1) Phoenix - Lisztomania (instant lift) 2) Burial - Archangel (quiet headspace) 3) Beyonce - Sandcastles (big feelings). Pair: The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle for odd, slow afternoons.
sarah: Love this. Mine: 1) Fleet Foxes - Blue Ridge Mountains 2) LCD Soundsystem - New York, I Love You But You're Bringing Me Down 3) Janelle Mone1e - Make Me Feel. Pair: Fleabag season 1 for the mood flip.
julia: tough to pick only three but: 1) M83 - Wait 2) Portishead - Roads 3) Chairlift - Bruises. sending heart emojis.
kevin: synthwave corner: 1) Kavinsky - Nightcall 2) Chromatics - Shadow 3) Perturbator - Future Club. immediate Drive energy. :sunglasses:
ben: cozy indie list: 1) Sufjan Stevens - Should Have Known Better 2) Angel Olsen - Windows 3) Radiohead - Sail to the Moon. book pair: Norwegian Wood.
nana: lol typo earlier (meant to be ana). wildcard: A-ha - Take On Me because meme energy cures everything. :joy: 
mike: adding Sandcastles to my commute playlist rn :heart:
sarah: tiny PSA: i auto-generated a playlist from these picks and the thread earlier, link if you want to listen: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/def456 (bot made it).
ben: voting for @mike's emotional roller capsule :1st_place_medal: 
kevin: can someone suggest a 3-song "monday debugging" survival capsule? i need something that keeps me focused but calm.
nana: @kevin i'll put one together after lunch. unrelated note: the office spider plant in the kitchen is drooping, if you're around please water it before 5pm :seedling:
julia: i'll water it tomorrow morning on my way in :ok_hand:
music-bot: Playlist "3-song-capsule-thread-1712349876" created (22 tracks) -- auto message.
nana: awesome thread, thanks all. if anybody wants their picks added to the main office mix, paste them here and i'll queue them up. :coffee:
